notes.title: Update Patch Notes - July 10, 2023
notes.content:
[h2]The following updates have been implemented:[/h2]

[b]Added [/b]"B" button support on the controller for exit in the Terminal.
[b]Added [/b]"Left Stick" support on the controller for move in the Terminal.
[b]Changed / Limited[/b] the maximum frequency of attack sound effects on all the turrets and enemies. (changed from tatatatatatatata to ta-ta-ta-ta...) :D

Happy gaming and have a nice day!

cheers,
@FobTi

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - April 6, 2023
notes.content:
[h3]The following updates have been implemented:[/h3]

[b]Added [/b]more info about Turrets and PowerUps + some useful Kitty tips into the How To Play section.
[b]Fixed [/b]Player collision with doors. Sometimes the door wouldn't open on the first try.
[b]Fixed [/b]/ Changed player collision with enemies. Player hitbox is now smaller.
[b]Fixed [/b]"larva bug". Sometimes the larva didn't turn into a small worm.

Happy gaming and have a nice day!

cheers,
@FobTi

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - February 5, 2021
notes.content:
[h3]The following updates have been implemented:[/h3]

[b]Changed[/b]: Coins and Energy are now permanently visible.

[b]Changed[/b]: HUD is now visible even if you are in the Terminal.

[b]Added [/b]flashing for PowerPlant icon if you don't have enough power.

[b]Added [/b]shorter time for bomb explosion and bigger hitbox.

[b]Added [/b]bigger damage for bombard tower.

[b]Changed [/b]price for bombard tower from 5 to 7.

[b]Added [/b]a little bit more HP for all the towers. (+5)

[b]Added [/b]4 new building places on the Floor 3.

[b]Changed [/b]graphics of building info.


[b]New Upgrades and Power-Ups coming soon![/b]


Enjoy the game! :)

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - January 27, 2021
notes.content:
[h1]The following updates have been implemented:[/h1]

[b]Fixed [/b]Pause function in the terminal.

[b]Added [/b]short invulnerability when entering to a new room.

[b]Changed [/b]the way how to take a watering-can from automatic to manual. (Press action button to take it) This give you time to explore more rooms or build a better defense.

[b]CONTINUE [/b]button are selected by default at the start of the title screen, if the game has been saved.

[b]Added [/b]flashing FX for hearts on the HUD panel if you lost your health.

Enjoy the game! :)
